items.prompt: At index 1, a newer value 4 replaces an older equal 4 as a trailing candidate. Why is this safe?

options.text: The older value must already be outside every possible future window.
options.why: It may still be inside some windows; immediate expiration is not the proof.

options.text: The newer equal value is just as large and expires no earlier.
options.why: Whenever the older equal could serve a future window, the newer one can serve at least as well.

options.text: Equal observations are merged into their sum 8.
options.why: No sum is stored or required for a maximum.

options.text: Removing it makes every single update worst-case constant time.
options.why: A later large arrival can still remove many different trailing candidates.

items.explanation: Whenever the older equal could serve a future window, the newer one can serve at least as well.
